settings.patch.enh_direct_pick.title: 1 - Direct pick
settings.patch.enh_direct_pick.desc: On: a click selects the deepest widget under the cursor (including one covered by a container). Off: stock behaviour, the outermost unlocked container first.
settings.patch.enh_drag_no_reparent.desc: On: dragging a widget only changes its x/y - it is never moved into a container and never extracted to the document root. Off: stock behaviour.
settings.patch.enh_axis_params.title: Two-axis size params
settings.patch.enh_axis_params.desc: Main axis (fixed/percent/remain) and cross axis (fixed/percent) size rules, shown as extra rows in the Layout group.
settings.patch.enh_batch_edit.title: Multi-select batch edit
settings.patch.enh_batch_edit.desc: Edit properties and axis params on several selected widgets in one step (single undo).
settings.patch.fix_place_composite.title: place container + composite child crash
settings.patch.fix_place_composite.desc: A CTkScrollableFrame (or other multi-part widget) inside a place parent is sized via configure before place, so the canvas no longer crashes.
settings.patch.fix_var_binding.title: Variable-bound grid_sticky / stretch
settings.patch.fix_var_binding.desc: A sticky / stretch bound to a variable no longer leaks the raw var: token; canvas and export both resolve the variable's current value.
settings.patch.fix_scroll_frame.title: Scroll-container children stretched
settings.patch.fix_scroll_frame.desc: Children of a CTkScrollableFrame are no longer stretched to the viewport, so the scroll region cannot collapse.
settings.patch.fix_geometry_sync.title: Canvas / model sync
settings.patch.fix_geometry_sync.desc: Sizes backfill from the rendered geometry and managed children drop their stale x/y, so the panel stops showing meaningless numbers.
settings.patch.fix_drag_behind.title: Drag grabs the widget behind
settings.patch.fix_drag_behind.desc: Pressing on an already-selected widget drags THAT widget instead of the container behind it.
settings.patch.compat_stock_rewrite.desc: On: a place parent holding a composite child is rewritten to vbox when saving, so stock 00 can open the project.
settings.patch.compat_px_disk.title: Exact px on disk (patch 4)
settings.patch.compat_px_disk.desc: A derived size is written as a plain height/width value on the widget itself; stretch is never touched (still fixed by default).
settings.patch.compat_px_export.title: Exact px on export (patch 5)
settings.patch.compat_px_export.desc: percent / remainder children ship exact px in the exported .py instead of the expand/grow path.

settings.editor.help_body:
Opens your script's .py file in a code editor and jumps to the method when you double-click an event or use the canvas right-click menu.

CHOOSING AN EDITOR
Auto — tries VS Code → Notepad++ → IDLE; first one found wins.
Or pick one: VS Code, Sublime Text, PyCharm, Notepad++, Cursor, IDLE. The "found ✓ / not found" tag shows if CTkMaker located it.

PATH TO EDITOR
Only needed when it isn't found automatically (portable install, unusual drive). Click Browse… and point at the editor's .exe.

OTHER EDITORS
Pick "Other…" and give the path. The file opens, though jump-to-line may not work if the editor's syntax is unknown.

FIX VS CODE IMPORT ERRORS
Writes .vscode/settings.json with the right Python path so Pylance stops flagging your imports red.

ADVANCED (CUSTOM COMMAND)
Write a raw launch command with placeholders: {file} = path, {line} = line number, {folder} = project root, {python} = interpreter.

Don't have VS Code?  https://code.visualstudio.com/download

font.help_text:
Choose a font family for this widget's text.

• + Import file — copy a .ttf / .otf from disk into the
    project's assets/fonts/ folder. Travels with the
    .ctkproj across machines.
• + Add system font — pick from the operating system's
    fonts and add it to this project's palette. The
    family name is saved with the project; users opening
    the exported app need the same font installed.

Apply to:
• This widget   — only the selected widget.
• All [Type]    — every widget of the same type that
    hasn't been overridden one-by-one.
• All in project — every text widget that hasn't been
    overridden by type or one-by-one.

Per-widget setting wins, then per-type, then project-wide.

props.help.prop.font_family.description: Font family name. Empty = inherit from the active theme.
props.help.prop.font_size.warning: Ignored while Auto Fit is on — autofit drives the size.
props.help.prop.font_autofit.description: Auto-shrink the font so the text fits within the widget bounds.
props.help.prop.font_autofit.warning: Overrides the manual Size value while enabled.
props.help.prop.font_bold.description: Render the text in bold weight.
props.help.prop.font_italic.description: Render the text in italic style.
props.help.prop.justify.description: Horizontal alignment for multi-line text. Single-line text is governed by Anchor.
props.help.prop.font_wrap.description: Enable word wrapping when the text is wider than the wrap length.
props.help.prop.wraplength.description: Maximum line width before text wraps to the next line. 0 = wrap at the widget's current width.
props.help.prop.text_color.description: Text color when the label is enabled.
props.help.prop.text_color_disabled.desc: Text color used when the label is disabled.
props.help.prop.image.description: PNG/icon shown alongside or instead of the text.
props.help.prop.image_color.description: Tint applied to the icon — replaces RGB, keeps alpha. Empty leaves the icon's native colors.
props.help.prop.image_color.warning: Has no effect when no image is set.
props.help.prop.image_color_disabled.des: Tint applied to the icon when the label is disabled.
props.help.prop.image_color_disabled.war: Has no effect when no image is set.
props.help.prop.image_width.warning: Has no effect when no image is set.
props.help.prop.image_height.warning: Has no effect when no image is set.
props.help.prop.compound.description: Position of the icon relative to the text.
props.help.prop.compound.warning: Has no effect when no image is set.
props.help.prop.preserve_aspect.descript: Keep the image's native aspect ratio — the icon is contain-fit inside the (W, H) box, scaled by the smaller side so it never stretches.
props.help.prop.preserve_aspect.warning: Has no effect when no image is set.
warnings.reset_cleared: Cleared {count} dismissed warning(s). They'll surface again on their next trigger.
props.label.label: Label
